title: scene-server: observerCount undercounts regions outside observer_accounts or gained later
description: From the h05q spec patch: only regions found at SceneStreamEnable time are passed to set_observing (crate-jmap-scene-server/src/websocket.rs ~462-489), while delivery checks any account and re-checks access per event. A region outside observer_accounts, or one the user gains access to after enable, gets events but is not counted. Also: in MemoryBackend a decline-policy change or an access change that is not a region update leaves observerCount stale until the next recount. Make counting follow delivery; tests.
